description: Two slots that set the playing level of a drum sound from a trigger, with a louder level for accented hits and an optional choke between the two

params.text: Switches choking on, so a trigger on either slot silences the other over 1ms
Sets the level that slot plays at when its TRG fires with ACC low, 0 to 200%
Sets the level that slot plays at when its TRG fires with ACC high, 0 to 200%

inputs.text: A trigger here reads the ACC jack and fixes that slot's level from the SLV or the ALV knob
Held above 1V as that slot's TRG fires, the ALV knob sets the level for that hit instead of the SLV knob
The drum sound for that slot, which is passed through at the level the last trigger fixed

outputs.text: That slot's sound at its set level; with the other slot's output empty, both slots are summed into whichever output has a cable

notes: with CHOKE on, a slot passes nothing until a trigger has arrived at its own TRG jack.
with CHOKE on and both TRG jacks triggered in the same sample, the upper slot takes the hit and the lower one is skipped.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
